The '''Linear Miasma Scientists''' were a group of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who studied the [[Linear Miasma]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. They belonged to the [[Endorian Researchers Guild]].<ref name="SWG:LM" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Linear Miasma Scientists were frequently threatened by a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], the [[Zynt'aia Spice Guardians]], who were very active near the nebula.<ref name="SWG:LM" /> While the scientists used [[Unidentified transport class|research vessels]] for their work, their guards piloted [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunters]] and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]].<ref name="SWG:ES">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Endor system}}</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the scientists were also present in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="SWG:YS" />
